title: ai powered suggestions

# Inline suggestions from GitHub Copilot in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Use inline suggestions when you want to keep writing code yourself, with help completing code, comments, or tests and making related edits. {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %} suggests changes in the editor as you type. You review each suggestion and decide whether to accept it, accept part of it, or keep typing. {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} uses your existing code as context for two kinds of suggestions: * **Ghost text suggestions**: Dimmed text at your cursor suggests how to complete the code you're writing. * **Next edit suggestions**: Based on your recent edits, {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} suggests another change and where to make it. You don't need to start a chat for inline suggestions. You can also [combine them with chat and agents](#combine-suggestions-with-chat-and-agents) as your task changes.
Follow a hands-on tutorial to build your first app with AI in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. * [Start tutorial](/docs/agents/agents-tutorial.md)
